meta.title: For server admins
meta.description: What Mewvo needs in your server and why, the first 10 minutes, what members see, appeals, data and limits per plan.

head.title: For server admins
head.lead: What to know before and after you add Mewvo to your server.

permissions.title: What Mewvo needs and why
permissions.intro: Mewvo asks for these permissions when you add it (permissions integer `{bits}`). It never asks for **Administrator**.
permissions.later: You can take a permission away later; only the feature that needs it stops working, and the dashboard shows what is missing. Mewvo's role must be above the roles it gives or takes, and it never acts on the server owner or on members whose highest role is equal to or above its own.

first.title: The first 10 minutes
first.intro: You need **Administrator** in the server (Manage Server is enough for settings). The [setup guide](/docs/setup) has more detail.

steps.setup: Run `/setup` in your server. It shows what is set up and what is missing, links the dashboard and lists every command. It changes nothing.
steps.dashboard: Open the [dashboard]({dashboard}), log in with Discord and pick your server. On the Overview page, **Set up Mewvo step by step** goes through the settings one at a time.
steps.logging: Pick a **mod log channel** that only staff can see: every warning, mute, kick and ban is written there. Other logs (joins, role changes, edited and deleted messages) are on the **Logging** page.
steps.automod: Automod is **off** in a new server. Turn it on on the **Automod** page and start with **Report only (don't delete)**: staff see what it would have done and nothing happens to anyone. Switch a rule to **On** when you trust it.
steps.staffGuard: The **staff guard** is off too. Turn it on with `/automod staffguard`: an admin who mass-bans, mass-kicks or mass-deletes channels or roles loses their staff roles and the server owner is alerted; `/staff restore` gives the roles back. It works while automod is on, and only the server owner can turn it off.
steps.appeals: Post the appeal panel with `/setappeal` in a channel every member can see.
steps.test: Run `/test` to get the exact DM a member would get. Nothing is done to anyone.

list.commands: Commands for everyone, such as `/help`, `/rank` and `/report`. Everything that moderates or changes settings needs Administrator. The [commands page](/commands) lists them.
list.dms: A DM for every warning, mute, kick and ban: the reason, the case code, until when, and how to appeal or that it can't be appealed.
list.appeals: The appeal panel from `/setappeal`, with **Appeal**, **My appeals** and **My record**.
list.record: Their own cases from every server that uses Mewvo on [My record](/me), on this website.
list.automod: When automod acts on them, a DM with the rule and a **Contest this** button. Staff get a review card where they keep, undo or change the action.

appeals.title: How appeals work for your server
appeals.who: Members appeal to the server that punished them, and your **Administrators** decide: **Accept** or **Deny** on the appeal card in your staff channel, or on the dashboard's **Appeals** page. An accepted appeal lifts what is still active; a ban or kick comes with a one-time invite back.
appeals.panel: **In Discord:** the appeal panel you post with `/setappeal`. Muted and warned members use it in your server.
appeals.web: **On the website:** members log in with Discord on [My appeals](/me/appeals). It works even after a ban, when they share no server with Mewvo any more.
appeals.home: You choose where the punishment DM tells members to appeal: on the dashboard, **Enforcement & appeals → Where members appeal**, pick **Mewvo support** (the Mewvo support server) or **Our own server** with an invite to a server you run.

data.title: Data and deletion
data.kept: Mewvo keeps your server's settings, cases, appeals and levels while it is in your server and after it is removed, so everything is back if you add it again. It is kept until the server owner asks for it to be deleted. The [privacy page](/privacy) lists what is stored and for how long.
data.delete: The server owner can ask for deletion in the dashboard. If Mewvo is already removed, ask through the [contact page](/contact) with the server's ID. Members can delete their own levels and personal data with `/wipedata` at any time; moderation records stay, as the privacy page explains.
